paite: Leitung leh asung a thil om tengteng TOUPA a ahi a; khovel leh asung a om tengteng toh;
heading: David La / Kumpipa Thupi
english: A Psalm by David. The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

paite: Tuipite tung a lei amah muhkhiak ahi a, tuite tung ah amah hihkip ahi.
english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

paite: TOUPA mual ah kua apaitou dia, amun siangthou ah kua ahia dingh ding?
english: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

paite: Khut siang leh lungtang siangthou nei a, alungsim thulim lou lam a koih ngei lou a, khem tum a kichiam ngei lou mi.
english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA kiang a kipan vualzawlna amu ding a, ahondampa Pathian kiang a kipan diktanna leng amu ding hi.
english: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

paite: Huai tuh amah zongmi suan ahi. Jakob' Pathian aw, na mel zongte mah. Selah
english: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

paite: Kongpite aw, na lutang uh sangsak un; nou tangtawn kongkhakte aw, kikhaisang un! Huchi a thupina Kumpipa ahong luttheihna ding in.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

paite: Thupina Kumpipa kua ahia? TOUPA hattak leh thilhihtheitak, TOUPA kidouna a thilhihtheitak, ahi!
english: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.

paite: Kongpite aw, na lutang uh sangsak unla, ahi, tangtawn kongkhakte aw, kikhaisang un! Huchi a thupina Kumpipa a hong luttheihna ding in.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

paite: Hiai thupina Kumpipa kua ahia? Sepaihte' TOUPA amah mah thupina Kumpipa ahi. Selah
english: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
